items.description:

possible.

* WHERE...Western Arctic Coast.

* WHEN...From late Wednesday night through Friday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, blow around unsecured

difficult.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 7 at 9:54AM AKDT until September 9 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...From 1 PM Tuesday to 1 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds are expected in the
afternoon hours with the initial frontal passage. A brief period of
gusts in excess of 50 mph is possible during that timeframe.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
